conventions.convention: Spacetime geometry uses η = diag(-1,1,1,1); Clifford and energy-momentum contractions use h = -η. Energy-vector components and rest energies are in joules, s is in joules squared, and inverse-length coordinates are converted by ℏc.

The positive massless shell excludes its apex. Phase space requires s > (M₁+M₂)². Ω is the sphere's chart surface Borel measure; Φ₂ is an angular measure, whereas its shell-pair pushforward is a distinct measure.

Formal scattering amplitudes are dimensionless Borel families with finite nonempty spin-label sets and normalized initial weights. The scattering map requires F > 0; S_f = 2 for identical daughters on the full labeled sphere and S_f = 1 for distinguishable daughters. Decay amplitudes have joule units, and the decay map permits +∞ unless integrability is imposed.

Spinors are normalized by √(2E); the Dirac adjoint is z†β. The locally defined P_± = (I + H_±/E)/2 use H_± = α·p ± βM; these local subscripts do not denote the supplier's complementary positive/negative-energy projections.

The magnetic calculation uses m > 0 in kilograms, real q in coulombs, smooth spatial A, B_k = ε_kij ∂_i A_j with ε₁₂₃ = 1, and π_i = -iℏ∂_i - qA_i. All compositions act on C_c^∞(R³;C⁴). 'Common core' means only the shared invariant test domain. The square-root correction and g_s = 2 are formal coefficient comparisons.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice and the example-data conventions, define dΦ₂ = k_* dΩ/(16π²√s), F = 4√((p₁·p₂)²-M₁,in²M₂,in²), dσ_coeff = (ℏc)² averaged|A|² dΦ₂/(F S_f) for F > 0, and Γ_coeff = ∫|G|²dΦ₂/(2ℏM₀S_f) for a rest parent, with the stated shell, threshold, Borel-amplitude and label hypotheses.

Under Countable Choice, the positive-shell measure is proper-orthochronous Lorentz invariant. For future-timelike total P with s > (M₁+M₂)², Φ₂,P is independent of the rest-frame map and has total k_*/(4π√s). For positive incoming flux, dσ_coeff/dΩ = (ℏc)²(k_*/p_*) averaged|A|²/(64π²s S_f). A rest parent M₀ > 2M with constant joule amplitude G_E and identical daughters has Γ_coeff = |G_E|²√(1-4M²/M₀²)/(32πℏM₀).

For the specified finite Dirac matrices and E = √(|p|²+M²) > 0, the normalized spin sums are Σu_s ū_s = slash(p)+M and Σv_s v̄_s = slash(p)-M. The stated two- and four-gamma traces hold, odd traces vanish, the columns satisfy their on-shell Dirac equations, and conjugating x̄γᵃy gives ȳγᵃx. The Dirac supplier's Countable Choice assumption is retained.

For m,M ≥ 0, positive-shell external vectors with common total and s > 4max(m²,M²), the stipulated single-photon amplitude with uniform initial-spin average has averaged|M|² = g⁴[3-β_e²-β_μ²+β_e²β_μ²cos²θ], and the displayed differential and total formal coefficient formulas. If δ = 4m²/s ≤ 1/2, its differential coefficient divided by the m = 0 value lies in [1,1+4δ]. Both total-momentum current contractions vanish, including zero masses.

For m > 0, real q and smooth A, on C_c^∞(R³;C⁴), [π_i,π_j] = iqℏε_ijkB_k and H_D² = m²c⁴I + c²(π²-qℏΣ·B). The first-degree formal square-root correction is K/(2m), with spin term -(q/m)S·B and minimal magnetic coefficient g_s = 2; no operator square-root or spectral assertion is made.

Under Countable Choice, equal-rest-energy positive-shell scalar scattering with common total, s > 4m² and constant real amplitude -λ has identical-final full-sphere coefficients dσ_coeff/dΩ = λ²(ℏc)²/(128π²s) and σ_coeff = λ²(ℏc)²/(32πs); distinguishable coefficients are twice these. The stated identical-daughter rest-parent decay coefficient is |G_E|²√(1-4m²/M₀²)/(32πℏM₀).
